name: ft-location-ip-prefix
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 3): the IP-prefix variation walks, re-based to the live local-mode app. The RFC-5737 table's labels (198.51.100.x -> TX, 203.0.113.x -> CO, loopback -> null) stay pinned by the r120 vitest suite; this E2E drives the VIEWS those labels produce through the REAL doors. LOCAL-MODE REWORK (disclosed in the results doc): the r120-era state seam (the persisted ft_location_context blob) no longer drives the doors after the R195 flip - the doors resolve the viewer's region SERVER-SIDE from the session profile row (route.ts: 'userState/userCity come from the VIEWER profile, the server-side source, never a client-asserted region'), so the out-of-region viewer is minted the honest local way: a fresh member registered WITH a CO city/state through the REAL register door (the register form's own optional location, R169 W-3), and the in-region/member legs ride Jordan (Austin/TX) whose profile location is edited through the REAL Settings door and restored. Legs: the honest loopback derivation (GET /api/location-context -> coarseRegion null); the IN-REGION leg (the TX-profile feed renders, the view the in-region coarse label produces - the r120 walk never asserted this leg); the MEMBER region-gate proof (Jordan edited to Denver/CO: the g_austin shell still opens for the member but its located-group posts gate to 0, restored to Austin/TX the posts return - the symmetric control); the OUT-OF-REGION default view (the CO-profile member: the feed drops all TX content, the groups directory loses the located TX groups while the unlocated ones pass, the g_austin shell reachable with 0 posts - for a non-member the privacy gate refuses first, disclosed - the unlocated g_bikes post renders as the positive control, RELOAD SURVIVAL); the explicit override (Nationwide) reveals the region again.

steps.name: honest-loopback-derivation-null
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/location-context', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 80) })()

steps.name: in-region-feed-tx-content
steps.expr: (() => { const n = document.querySelectorAll('.ft-stagger > *').length; return 'cards=' + (n === 0 ? 'zero' : 'positive') + ' bike=' + document.body.innerText.includes('Vintage steel road bike') })()

steps.name: out-of-region-feed-zero-cards-server-side-source
steps.expr: (() => { const n = document.querySelectorAll('.ft-stagger > *').length; const raw = localStorage.getItem('ft_location_context'); let coarse = 'absent'; if (raw) { try { coarse = String((JSON.parse(raw) || {}).coarseRegion) } catch (e) { coarse = 'unparsable' } } return 'cards=' + n + ' clientBlobCarriesCo=' + (coarse === 'CO') })()

steps.name: located-groups-gone-unlocated-pass
steps.expr: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('[data-testid=open-group-g_austin]'); const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=open-group-g_bikes]'); return 'austin=' + (a ? 'present' : 'gone') + ' bikes=' + (b ? 'present' : 'gone') })()
